products.description:
Make every Netskope policy follow the user — via Entra ID single sign-on

Network-security policy that isn't tied to identity is blunt: you can't write rules per user or group, and admins juggle separate logins. This solution integrates Netskope with Microsoft Entra ID for SSO and identity-based policy — SAML single sign-on for admins and users, SCIM user/group provisioning, and policies that steer and enforce by identity and group, so the right controls follow the right people everywhere.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the IdP integration model, SAML SSO, SCIM user/group provisioning into Netskope, identity-based steering and policy, and how it complements (not duplicates) Entra Conditional Access.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant, Entra ID with the rights to register apps/SCIM, user/group structure, the Netskope client, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: configure SAML SSO between Entra ID and Netskope, enable SCIM provisioning, map groups, build identity-based steering and policy, validate sign-in and policy targeting, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — SSO/SCIM-readiness discovery, sign-in and provisioning validation, an identity-policy coverage report, safe remediation of provisioning gaps, and an identity-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Netskope policy that follows the user — Entra ID single sign-on, SCIM-provisioned users and groups, and identity-based steering and enforcement — so the right controls reach the right people everywhere, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NSSSO-Discovery.ps1 — Netskope + Entra ID SSO/SCIM readiness discovery (read-only)
    • NSSSO-Remediation.ps1 — safely close common provisioning-scope gaps (default -WhatIf)
    • NSSSO-Report.ps1 — Netskope SSO/SCIM coverage report (read-only)
    • NSSSO-Set-IdentityScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/ensure the Netskope identity scope groups (default -WhatIf)
    • NSSSO-Validation.ps1 — confirm Netskope SSO is configured and SCIM provisioning is enabled (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
